sources.name: jobs.ac.uk
sources.note: Search view shows location; category view does not. Year digits are not printed next to DD-MMM dates on search pages and were resolved to 2026 by cross-checking full DD/MM/YYYY dates on the category view for overlapping job IDs. Category page 1 served a stale edge cache (May 2026 content) and was discarded.

sources.name: AcademicPositions.com
sources.note: Server-rendered. Exposes title, employer, city, country, absolute URL, sometimes salary and an ISO deadline. Never exposes department or absolute posted dates (relative strings only).

sources.name: THE unijobs
sources.note: Listings route is robots-permitted; the RSS feed is not. Category slug is polluted with non-postdoc roles, which were excluded. No deadline dates, only countdown text.

sources.name: researchersjob.com
sources.note: Each record's deadline was read from the individual post page, not guessed from the listing.

sources.name: IndiaBioscience
sources.note: Life sciences only. Deadlines render without a year, so deadline left null.

sources.name: IIT Delhi
sources.note: Index shows no deadline or posted date. Links point to PDF advertisements; no HTML permalink exists.

sources.name: JREC-IN Portal (Japan)
sources.note: QUARANTINED BY CONTROL PROBE. Requests for three deliberately invalid job IDs each returned complete, plausible postings instead of an error; two were byte-identical. The site executes search via POST with server-side session state and renders rows client-side, so a plain GET returns no listings and the fetch layer confabulated. Zero records accepted. Needs a JS-capable browser fetch.

sources.name: Academic Jobs Online
sources.note: Rows were readable with [POSTDOC] tags and deadlines, but no per-row hyperlink survived the fetch. Records without an individual posting URL are rejected by policy, so all were dropped. Every visible row was also long expired (2019 deadlines).

sources.name: EURAXESS
sources.note: robots.txt ends with 'Disallow: /jobs/*' and 'Disallow: /*?', closing the search and every detail page plus all pagination. Also disallows */api/*, */rest/*, /*?_format=json. Not polled. The only sanctioned integration is institutions pushing XML in, via support@euraxess.eu.

sources.name: Nature Careers
sources.note: robots.txt disallows /naturecareers/jobs/search and /naturecareers/jobsrss/, and issues 'Disallow: /' for User-Agent anthropic-ai and ClaudeBot by name. Not polled.

sources.name: FindAPostDoc
sources.note: 403 on robots.txt and every listing path. The one route that responds served postings with 2017 deadlines. Rejected as a stale-data hazard.

sources.name: HigherEdJobs
sources.note: Incapsula WAF challenge on both the RSS path and search. Not pollable without dedicated anti-bot handling.

sources.name: ANRF / CSIR / DST (India, government)
sources.note: ANRF renders calls into empty client-side containers. CSIR-HRDG's front door is a language-selection splash and its RA page is a static guidelines document with no announcement stream. DST's announcement list carries no dates at all and is dominated by Director-level administrative vacancies. Payloads are PDFs. No per-position stream exists to ingest.
